method: Labelled by eye. The minimal FFmpeg build has no PNG encoder (and no tile/drawtext), so frames were decoded read-only with OpenCV (venv cv2.VideoCapture, sequential grab; t = frame_index / container fps). Kill-feed crop x=600,y=55,w=360,h=180 (source px), scaled 1.75x, sampled every 0.5 s into 3x5 contact sheets with timestamp + frame index drawn on each tile; every sheet was viewed. Each candidate row was then pinned with per-frame (1/30 s) sheets of the top rows (x=600,y=55,w=360,h=80 at 1.2x). t = first frame on which the row (including its solid-colour slide-in bar) is visible. Own rows identified by the yellow chevron/edge on the player's side of the row (player name in-game is 'Me'), cross-checked against the on-screen combat report (KILLED YOU / KILLED). Detector output was not consulted.
